newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: European bunkers sink with thin buying.
newsitem.headline: European bunkers sink with thin buying.

text.p: Rotterdam fuel oil bunkers softened on Wednesday, due to the relative weakness of demand and ample prompt supply, while prices in the rest of Europe also dipped, dealers said.
Rotterdam 380 CST fuel oil bunkers were sold for as low as $83/$83.25 fob, although most offers were nearer $84
Total ARA bunker demand was around 15,000 tonnes.
"It's basically average. It's certainly not good," one supplier said.
Hamburg prices were also slightly lower at around $91 delivered.
Mediterranean bunkers were on average $1 for fuel oil and $2 $2 for gas oil. Except for Spanish ports, most areas were quiet.
Fujairah was unchanged and very calm, largely because of a national holiday in Singapore.
